outposts.name: Shaniwar Wada
outposts.desc: 18th-century seven-story fortified palace seat of the Peshwa prime ministers of the Maratha Empire with colossal teak bastions.

outposts.name: Sinhagad Fort
outposts.desc: Historic 17th-century Maratha fortress perched on an isolated cliff in the Bhuleshwar range, renowned for Tanaji Malusare heroic assault.

outposts.name: Rajgad Fort
outposts.desc: The Sovereign Capital of the Maratha Empire under Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj for over 25 years, with massive machis and citadel fortifications.

outposts.name: Torna Fort (Prachandagad)
outposts.desc: The highest hill fort in Pune district, captured by Shivaji at age 16; features the precarious Zunjar and Budhla Machi ridges.

outposts.name: Lohagad Fort
outposts.desc: Formidable Iron Fort featuring four sequential defense gates and the dramatic Vinchukata (scorpion tail) razor cliff projecting into the valley.

outposts.name: Pawna Lake & Valley
outposts.desc: Sprawling freshwater reservoir nestled beneath Lohagad, Tikona, and Tung hill forts, known for shoreline camping and water excursions.

outposts.name: Tamhini Ghat
outposts.desc: Spectacular Western Ghats mountain pass linking the Deccan plateau to the Konkan coast, famous for cascading waterfalls and emerald mist.

outposts.name: Lonavala & Khandala
outposts.desc: Popular Sahyadri mountain gateway famous for Tiger Leap viewpoint, Bhushi Dam cascades, and ancient Karla Buddhist rock-cut caves.

outposts.name: Mahabaleshwar & Panchgani
outposts.desc: Vast Sahyadri hill station plateau with 30 panoramic viewpoints overlooking the Krishna River basin and dense evergreen forest valleys.

outposts.name: Kaas Plateau (Valley of Flowers)
outposts.desc: UNESCO World Natural Heritage volcanic laterite plateau exploding with vibrant endemic wild flower blooms every August to October.

outposts.name: Murud-Janjira & Alibaug
outposts.desc: Impregnable island sea fortress built by the Siddis in the Arabian Sea surrounded by coconut groves and coastal fishing hamlets.

outposts.name: Harishchandragad & Konkan Kada
outposts.desc: Monumental 6th-century fortress famed for the sheer concave overhang of Konkan Kada and the semi-submerged Kedareshwar cave.

outposts.name: Malshej Ghat Pass
outposts.desc: High mountain pass carved into rugged Deccan basalt traps, hosting migratory flamingos and continuous roadside cloud waterfalls.

outposts.name: Ellora & Daulatabad Citadel
outposts.desc: World Heritage rock-cut cave temples centered on the monolithic Kailasa temple carved from a single basalt cliff face, alongside Daulatabad Fort.

outposts.name: Saputara Hill Station
outposts.desc: Gujarat premier Sahyadri hill retreat set amid the lush Dang tribal forest, famous for Sunrise Point and Gira waterfalls.

outposts.name: Surat & Dumas Shoreline
outposts.desc: Historic Mughal and colonial diamond trade port on the Tapti River mouth and black sand Dumas beach.

outposts.name: Statue of Unity & Kevadia
outposts.desc: World tallest 182-meter monumental colossus of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel towering over the Narmada river and Sardar Sarovar reservoir.

outposts.name: Champaner-Pavagadh UNESCO Park
outposts.desc: UNESCO World Heritage archaeological landscape with Kalika Mata temple atop Pavagadh hill and 15th-century sultanate citadel.

outposts.name: Lothal Indus Valley Port
outposts.desc: Ancient 2400 BCE Harappan civilization port featuring the world earliest known tidal dockyard and bead-making workshops.

outposts.name: Somnath Shoreline Jyotirlinga
outposts.desc: Sacred first Jyotirlinga shrine standing at the holy Triveni Sangam on the shores of the Arabian Sea.

outposts.name: Gir National Park & Lion Sanctuary
outposts.desc: Sole global refuge of the endangered Asiatic Lion in rugged dry deciduous scrub and teak forest.

outposts.name: Asirgarh Fort (Key to the Deccan)
outposts.desc: Formidable Satpura mountain fortress historically guarding the major pass connecting northern India to the Deccan.

outposts.name: Maheshwar Narmada Ghats & Ahilya Fort
outposts.desc: Ahilya Bai Holkar historic royal capital with monumental carved stone ghats descending into the sacred Narmada river.

outposts.name: Mandu Citadel (City of Joy)
outposts.desc: Spectacular medieval fortified citadel with the floating Jahaz Mahal palace, Hindola Mahal, and Rani Roopmati Pavilion.

outposts.name: Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga Island
outposts.desc: Revered island Jyotirlinga temple situated in the sacred Om-shaped Mandhata island on the Narmada.

outposts.name: Ujjain Mahakaleshwar & Ram Ghat
outposts.desc: Ancient holy city on the Shipra River with the sacred Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga and historic Jantar Mantar observatory.

outposts.name: Bhimbetka Rock Shelters UNESCO
outposts.desc: UNESCO World Heritage Paleolithic and Mesolithic rock art complex featuring cave paintings over 30,000 years old.

outposts.name: Pachmarhi Queen of Satpura
outposts.desc: Madhya Pradesh highest hill resort within the Satpura Tiger Reserve, renowned for Dhoopgarh peak and Bee Falls.

outposts.name: Sanchi Great Stupa UNESCO
outposts.desc: Oldest stone structure in India commissioned by Emperor Ashoka in 3rd century BCE with intricately carved Buddhist toranas.
